answer:
You can now change the monthly limit yourself. On the App side of Household expenses there's a new Settings section at the bottom with a "Monthly limit (kr)" field. It starts at 12 000 kr. Whatever you type applies straight away, with no Save button.

I also fixed a bug that was already there. The app looked for an "Amount" column, but your table's column is called "Amt". It never found your data and only showed "Add a table with an Amount column." It now reads "Amt". I also added labels to the add-expense fields and made the Add button easier to read.

The "left of 12 000 kr" figure still adds up every row in the table, including September's. If you'd rather it count only the current month, I can change that.
